narrative:
Gamma 3-statement model — FY2025 actuals reconciled. Revenue GBP 645.8M, gross profit GBP 348.1M (53.9%), adjusted EBITDA GBP 140.4M (21.7%) against the published GBP 141.7M. Balance sheet balanced.

Income statement: cost of sales 46.1% of revenue; D&A on network, right-of-use assets and capitalised software.

Balance sheet: accrued unbilled usage, deferred rental income, partner receivables (DSO 38 days), acquired intangibles from Germany and the EUR sub-ledger modelled.

Cash flow: high cash conversion — low capex relative to EBITDA.

signals.excerpt: SQL Server finance and billing GL accounts mapped to the planning COA. V_MAPPED_ACTUALS reconciles to the trial balance within rounding.
